summary: Frontend-only smoke + visual verification of the About ('Über mich') background-image fix and surrounding sections on http://localhost:3000 (static site). The high-res ueber-bg.png is now served correctly and all related UI behaves as specified.
verifications: GET /ueber-bg.png -> HTTP 200, content-type image/png, content-length 3,658,890 bytes (high-res, no 404, no broken asset).
Computed style on #ueber.about-section: background-image = url('http://localhost:3000/ueber-bg.png'), background-size: cover, background-position: 50% 42%.

Desktop (1920x1080): #ueber width=1920, height≈878. .about-content has max-width 44% (computed 506.875px), margin-left: 645.125px, contentLeft=1029.125, contentRight=1536 — text content sits on the RIGHT half, leaving the LEFT half for the doctor photo (matches spec).
About content text verified: eyebrow 'ÜBER MICH', heading 'Arzt mit langjähriger Erfahrung', 2 paragraphs, 3 bullet items, green 'Termin vereinbaren' button.

[data-testid='about-booking-btn'] is present, visible, enabled; tag=BUTTON, onclick='openBooking()', text 'Termin vereinbaren'. (openBooking triggers tel:012141431 by design — not invoked in headless browser as per instructions.)

[data-testid='accessibility-toggle'] toggles body.accessibility-mode. In accessibility mode: #ueber background-image computes to 'none', .about-section::before display: none, .about-content max-width: 100%, margin-left: 0px — text spans full width and stays readable.
Zero console errors and zero network failures (no responses >= 400) during page load and interactions.
critical_code_review_comments: styles.css is large (~1500+ lines) and could benefit from splitting (e.g., layout, accessibility, sections) for maintainability — non-blocking.

ueber-bg.png is ~3.5 MB; consider also generating a WebP/AVIF variant + <picture>/image-set for the CSS background to cut LCP on the About section, especially on mobile data. Currently the fix is correct but heavy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site served via Express from /app/static-website on port 3000 (see /app/frontend/serve.js). All About-section assertions in this iteration pass; only optional perf optimisation (WebP/AVIF, responsive bg) remains. Booking buttons intentionally use tel: links — don't expect HTTP navigation when clicked.
